item.title: Iran to execute first female protester tied to anti-regime unrest
item.summary: Iran prepares to execute its first female protester tied to the 2026 Tehran uprising as human rights groups warn of a deepening crackdown.

item.title: Trump to be honored by CNN's potential new owner ahead of White House Correspondents' Dinner
item.summary: President Donald Trump is reportedly being honored at a dinner hosted by Paramount CEO David Ellison, who may be the next owner of CNN as he pursues a Warner Bros. Discovery takeover.

item.title: LA hotel leaders warn Mayor Bass' $30 wage mandate is killing business ahead of World Cup, Olympics
item.summary: Los Angeles hotels are "sounding alarm bells" over a $30-per-hour minimum wage law, according to an AHLA report citing reduced hiring and canceled investments.

item.title: 'Happy Days' star Henry Winkler filmed his first-ever nude scene at 79
item.summary: Henry Winkler revealed on "Jimmy Kimmel Live" that he shot his first career nude scene at 79 for the hit Maya Rudolph comedy series "Loot."

item.title: Starbucks uses ChatGPT to suggest drinks based on mood as expert warns of hidden downsides
item.summary: Starbucks is testing a ChatGPT beta app that helps customers choose beverages based on mood, taste and goals before ordering through the Starbucks app.

item.title: LIV Golf CEO sends rallying memo to staff after reports Saudi funding could end after this season
item.summary: In response to reports that Saudi Arabia will stop funding LIV Golf after 2026, CEO Scott O'Neil sent a memo rallying staff to embrace the moment and push on.

item.title: NFL begins onboarding replacement officials as referee labor deal nears expiration: report
item.summary: The NFL has reportedly started background checks on replacement officials as the current collective bargaining agreement with the NFLRA nears expiration.

item.title: Kevin Sorbo says he ‘escaped’ California, slams Democratic leadership in fiery remarks
item.summary: Kevin Sorbo slams Democratic leadership and says he escaped California for Florida, praising Gov. Ron DeSantis as the best governor in the country.

item.title: Navy reservist accused of murdering wife and hiding her body in freezer arrested after international manhunt
item.summary: The FBI announced the overseas arrest of Navy reservist David Varela, who is accused of murdering his wife, whose body was found in a freezer in Norfolk, Virginia.

item.title: Elizabeth Banks admits she cannot understand White women who voted for Trump over Harris
item.summary: Elizabeth Banks criticized White women who backed Trump, says she doesn’t understand them and urges women to be “revolutionaries" like her “Hunger Games" character.
